points.why: It names Fixes That Fail as the main structure.
It traces the balancing quick-fix loop (B1) and the delayed reinforcing side-effect loop of staleness, distrust and more caches (R1).
It recommends using caches as a bridge while fixing the root cause of the slowness, but never says to ask what each fix does a few rounds out.

pitfalls.why: It invokes Shifting the Burden only with a competing fundamental fix (queries, model, metric definitions) and explicit capability erosion (R3).
